text:
matt.perez: Quick sync — product asked for a new dashboard slice showing routing policy hits + quota enforcement failures by model variant and region. We need infra/runtime metrics in the pipeline to make that reliable.

sara.kim: +1. Can you list exact metrics we need? is this just counters or also latency histograms?

matt.perez: Counters for routing decisions: route_evaluated, route_chosen{policy,variant,region}, fallback_triggered. Quotas: quota_check{ok,denied}, quota_remaining gauge per-tenant. Also per-request p50/p95 latency from runtime (not infra agent) so we can correlate routing vs latency.

leo.chang: For aggregation we should emit 1s counters and use a rollup job to 1m/5m for dashboards. High cardinality tags we should avoid: tenant_id becomes expensive. Suggest we keep tenant_id only for a sampled subset (sampling tags).

rachel.liu: Important: retention/volume concern. If we keep 1s counters for all variants/regions for 90d that's huge. What's the retention target for dashboards vs audit logs? Product wants 90d on dashboard trends, but maybe we can keep high-res for 7d then downsample.

john.ops: Agree with downsampling. Proposed retention plan: raw 1s for 7d, 1m rollups for 90d, 1h rollups for 365d. Audit-grade events (quota deny) get full 90d raw. Does that cover compliance?

matt.perez: That seems reasonable. For quota deny we need fine-grained logs for debugging, so keep raw events for 90d but only include hashed tenant id + request id (no PII).

leo.chang: Implementation notes: runtime exporter needs to add these metrics with stable metric names and label sets: metric names I2 propose: redwood_runtime_route_eval_total, redwood_runtime_route_choice_total, redwood_runtime_fallback_total, redwood_quota_check_total, redwood_quota_remaining. Labels: policy, variant, region, sampled_tenant (optional).

devops-bot: Exporter repo CI: new metrics detected in dev branch. Follow semantic metrics review checklist: add unit tests, update promdoc, bump exporter version.

rachel.liu: Backfill question: product wants 30 days of historical routing trends. We don't have those metrics yet. Can we backfill from request logs? That's an infra cost question.

john.ops: We can run a batch job to reprocess request logs to generate 1m rollups for the last 30d. Estimate: 2-3 cloud-hours per day of logs; cost ~ $X. Need approval from finance if > $Y.

matt.perez: OK can we scope the backfill: only top-10 variants + global+us-west regions to start, so smaller compute. If that gives product enough signal we avoid full backfill.

leo.chang: Sounds good. I'll write the aggregator job to be parameterized by variant list and time window. It will emit Prometheus-compatible metrics to the long-term TSDB.

sara.kim: UX question: how will these metrics surface in the Console? We need per-route drilldowns and an example chart for quota denies over time + sample request traces.

matt.perez: Console team — we'll add a new "Routing" section under Model Insights. Charts: routing policy distribution, fallback rate, quota denial rate, latency by variant. Drilldowns will link to traces (trace id) and logs.

rachel.liu: On retention: make sure 1) we have clear doc describing retention/downsampling, 2) alerting for aggregator failures, and 3) data access controls so only SRE/product can query tenant-sampled metrics.

devops-bot: Alert created: AGG-ROUTING-FAIL (agg job failures) -> pager on call for eng-oncall.

john.ops: I'll open a finance ticket for the backfill budget and attach cost estimate. Also prepping IAM roles for the aggregator to write to TSDB.

matt.perez: Next actions: @leo.chang add metrics to runtime exporter PR, include promdoc + tests. @john.ops draft backfill budget & IAM. @sara.kim coordinate Console mockups. I'll sync product and confirm which variants to backfill (top-10). We'll reconvene mid-week. :thumbsup:

sara.kim: Sounds good. I'll post mockups by EOD Wednesday.

leo.chang: Working on PR, will tag reviewers. Expect export schema + sample metrics in dev environment tomorrow.

rachel.liu: I'll draft the retention doc and link to console mockups.

matt.perez: Thanks everyone — closing for now. If anyone hits blockers ping in this thread.
